evidence: PATHS: instruction.md names exactly /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md and /assets/seed_data.json; all three exist under task/environment/ (instructions/hireops_rules.md 10911 B, instructions/integration.md 1090 B, assets/seed_data.json 28549 B). task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical in content to the template Dockerfile and contains 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/' followed by 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. No other /assets or /instructions path is referenced by the brief, rules or seed (seed generated_note points to /instructions/hireops_rules.md, which exists). Template's placeholder instructions/notes.md is not shipped and is not referenced anywhere. seed_data.json parses as JSON. CONTENT vs BRIEF/RULES: brief and rules section 9 promise people, three jobs with cards in order, messages with one long conversation, a few internal notes, read markers, candidate wording and page size 30 in the same file. Seed has users=10 (3 recruiter, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidate) with exactly the ten emails/roles listed in instruction.md and app_context.md; jobs=3 with interview_limit 3/2/3 (within 1-50); applications=16 with contiguous positions 1..n per (job,stage); messages=127 (APP-101 has 120, strictly time-ordered per conversation); notes=3; reads=6 (read_count semantics 'messages counted from first' match rules line 207); candidate_status_labels exactly match the rules section 7 table; thread_page_size=30. Integrity: no orphan sender/application/job ids; every message sender is legitimately a participant (candidate senders own the application, no observer messages, managers only on own jobs); APP-301 is REJECTED with rejected_from SCREEN and a reason (exercises the rejected-from rule); seed holds no passwords (password only in brief). Candidate-account emails link to applications APP-101/APP-302 (Noor), APP-201 (Tomas), APP-301 (Lena) as rules section 2 says. Interview occupancy is within limits (PLAT 2/3, DATA 1/2, DSGN 1/3). CONTENT vs JUDGES: functional Z/344 expects Lena 1 unread on Product Designer: APP-301 has 3 messages (REC3, CAN3, REC3), Lena read_count 2 -> last REC3 message unread = 1. Z/416 expects PLAT Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz: seed positions 1,2,3 and 1,2 match. Noor's card note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' is APP-101's note verbatim. app_context.md 'Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation is long (120 messages at the start)' matches 120; T/326/335 paging (30 newest, then 30 at a time with remaining count) is exercisable with 120 (> 3 pages). U scrolled-up uses Noor's long conversation and Rafael (read_count 120, so 0 unread at start). Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201) exists as the T/U/K fallback. Visual 'Board for a job with cards in several stages (a seeded job is fine)': PLAT has Applied/Screen/Interview/Offer. K: Noor sees two applications (Interviewing, Application received); Lena's rejected card renders 'Not moving forward'. CONTENT vs SOLUTION: solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c806b54da99a37ab2b5f455ede0a9385a09569903fb3a7f3446f7e83740 for both, matching the raw-evidence-index matching_source_files entry); db.js loads it via path.join(__dirname,'seed_data.json') (respects brief 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets ... unavailable at runtime') and consumes every field the seed ships (candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, interview_limit, recruiter_id/manager_id, position, rejected_from, reject_reason, read_count -> message id mapping, notes). Re-verified hashes: workspace.json ddfb53ec...b199517 and workspace.cjs 6aa75874...18af5 match the index; that scripted golden run (not a judge run) reports thread paging 30 at a time and unread checks passed. ADVERSARIAL: (a) broken app that could pass: an app ignoring the seed or reseeding/duplicating would fail Z/D (order + note before and after restart) and Lena's starting unread; seed is distinctive enough that a hard-coded fake would need the real data anyway. (b) conforming alternative that could fail: an app reading /assets at runtime is explicitly disallowed by the brief; an app that interprets read_count literally per rules line 207 gets Lena=1 and Rafael=0 on APP-101, consistent with judges. Polish forbids Lena's conversation and visual/gates do not open conversations, so the starting-count dependency in Z is protected; Noor's conversation counts are read relatively (remaining count 'until none remain'). No mismatch found. OUT-OF-ROW OBSERVATION (not graded here): task/environment/instructions/integration.md differs from the template copy by an added 5-line paragraph (lines 15-19, symlink/NODE_PATH guidance); content is consistent with the solution (ordinary files, NODE_PATH), but whether integration.md is template-controlled should be confirmed by the template-preservation/deterministic reviewer. Not measured: no Docker image build was run in this review (not permitted), so COPY staging is established from Dockerfile source, not an image inspection.
